question: What do you call a component of identical size that offers a higher resistance to electricity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Poor conductor.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A poor conductor** call a component of identical size that offers higher resistance to electricity
 
• A material with high resistivity which means it has got high resistance and will resist the flow of electrons is called** insulating material.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Resistivity **is the resistance per unit length and **cross-sectional area.**

 
 
• It is the property of the material that opposes the flow of charge or the flow of electric current.
 
• The unit of resistivity is an ohm meter.
 
 
 
• A material with very low resistivity means it has very low resistance and thus the electrons will flow smoothly through the material called **conducting material.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**
